integrity: A fully analytic determinant-and-monotonicity proof accompanies exact-rational reproducibility checks. Sampling is corroborative, not a proof of the universal quantified claim.
scientific_limitations: The result classifies the mean conservative potential torque only, not the nonlocal probability current, total work including jumps, entropy production, or heat-engine efficiency. Strictly positive thermal diffusivities, positive-definite symmetric harmonic drift, and one contracting coordinate reset are assumed. Priority against all specialized literature is not conclusively established.
title: A unique resetting-induced torque reversal in a two-bath Brownian gyrator
